name: Air Plant
hook: Air plant rotting? Dry it upside down after a soak.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: An east or west window is ideal. Outdoors, keep it in shade so the sun doesn't scorch it.

steps.title: Soak once a week
steps.tip: Submerge in room-temperature water for 20–60 minutes weekly. Soak less often in winter.

steps.title: Dry it upside down
steps.tip: Shake out the water and dry it upside down for 4+ hours with good airflow, or the base can rot.

steps.title: Warm days, mild nights
steps.tip: Keep days at 18–32°C and nights above 13°C, away from heaters and air-con vents.

steps.title: Feed monthly, very weak
steps.tip: Once a month, add bromeliad or air plant feed to the soak water at a quarter strength.

steps.title: Split off the pups
steps.tip: It blooms once, then makes pups. Separate them at a third of the mother's size, or keep the clump.

outro: Soak it, dry it upside down, give it light: no soil required.
